title: JSON Forms Extended UI schema
description: Implemented serialized UI vocabulary, verified against the reference renderer implementation. Unknown extensions remain open; acceptance of an unknown key does not imply support. Unimplemented and provisional features are tracked in TODO.md.

type.description: Element discriminator. The common profile admits its documented types; the extended profile preserves unknown types.

showValidationIndicatorCount.description: Opt in to computing and presenting the container error count. Omitted or false uses an error-presence marker without computing a count.

i18n.description: Translation key for this element's own text.

name.description: Stable local element name for category selection, composition and action fallback.

byType.description: Per-type shape. Written as if/then so an unknown `type` still validates - a renderer set downstream may contribute its own.

gridColumns.description: Horizontal layouts only. A child's `span` is read against this.

collapsed.description: Initial state, synchronized only when the effective collapsed option changes.

variant.description: Omit for tabs; canonical alternatives are stepper and accordion. Unknown variants require a runtime fallback.

initial.description: Name of a direct Category child; not an index. Runtime diagnoses an absent or hidden match.

scope.description: JSON Pointer into the schema, e.g. `#/properties/name`.

controlOptions.description: Options a Control may carry. Which apply depends on the schema the scope resolves to; this schema does not try to correlate the two, because the renderer chosen depends on the data schema, not on the UI schema alone.

format.description: Presentation hint; never rewrites the data schema format. Unknown or unavailable formats remain valid authoring values; renderer capability determines their presentation.

variant.description: Canonical presentation selector. OTP applies to password strings with minLength and positive maxLength; tuple/chips/multi-select/ag-grid apply to appropriate arrays. This schema cannot resolve applicability against the external data schema. Unsupported values remain open for extensions and are diagnosed at runtime.

restrict.description: Prevention rather than only validation, for this control.

elementLabelProp.description: Item-relative dotted DATA path for an item's header label - not a JSON pointer.

childLabelProp.description: Legacy alias of elementLabelProp. The specification says not to introduce an additional alias; it is read for compatibility.

showSortButtons.description: Table and expandable: Move up/down. AG Grid: a drag-handle column.

hideArraySummaryValidation.description: Hides the child-error summary only. Validation is unaffected, and the array's own error explanation remains.

table.description: Forces the table renderer for an array whose items nest, which the detail renderer would otherwise outrank.

cells.description: Per-column options handed to the composite cell, keyed by property name.

showTypeIndicator.description: Show an object or array type marker in a composite cell, independently of its summary.

showEmptyButton.description: Adds Clear to a composite detail dialog.

okLabel.description: Used as an i18n key first, literally if it does not resolve.

showBorder.description: Tuple control: encloses the heading and positions.

formatMinimum.description: Comparable temporal/duration string, original file byte count, or a supported data reference; applicability is checked at runtime.

formatMaximum.description: Comparable temporal/duration string, original file byte count, or a supported data reference; applicability is checked at runtime.

formatExclusiveMinimum.description: Comparable temporal/duration string, original file byte count, or a supported data reference; applicability is checked at runtime.

formatExclusiveMaximum.description: Comparable temporal/duration string, original file byte count, or a supported data reference; applicability is checked at runtime.

views.description: Which panels the picker offers. Date views select the calendar's granularity; time views select which time columns are drawn. The finest date view named is where the calendar lands. It does not change the save format - a year/month picker storing a full date is a legitimate request, and asking for hours and minutes does not stop seconds being stored. An array naming no view of a kind the control uses leaves that half to the display format, rather than blanking it. Views the control cannot use are accepted and ignored.

:language.description: Dotted data path whose value chooses the language at runtime.

convertJson.description: Edit the parsed JSON value rather than the source text.

propagateErrors.description: Publish owned renderer errors to host additional errors; opt-in, default false.

agGridOptions.description: AG Grid-specific configuration. A control's object replaces config.agGridOptions. Explicit pagination settings override their portable equivalents; columnDefs replaces the portable column list and supports richer native definitions.

components.description: Components a template may reference by name.

showValidationIndicatorCount.description: Opt in to computing and presenting the container error count. Omitted or false uses an error-presence marker without computing a count.

readOnly.description: Core alias of readonly; readonly takes precedence when both are present.

showArrayTableSortButtons.description: Legacy table sorting flag, combined with showSortButtons using logical OR. Prefer showSortButtons.

showArrayLayoutSortButtons.description: Legacy expandable array sorting flag, combined with showSortButtons using logical OR. Prefer showSortButtons.

columnDefs.description: Selects and orders table or AG Grid columns with optional width constraints. Explicit agGridOptions.columnDefs replaces this list for AG Grid.

validateActiveBranch.description: Validate the displayed anyOf/oneOf branch for local editor feedback. Control options override global config. False skips additional branch compilation and validation; document validation remains unchanged.

object-detail.description: Mixed editor detail override when object is selected. Takes precedence over detail; scoped to that value.

array-detail.description: Mixed editor detail override when array is selected. Takes precedence over detail; scoped to that value.

string-detail.description: Mixed editor detail override when string is selected. Takes precedence over detail; scoped to that value.

number-detail.description: Mixed editor detail override when number is selected. Takes precedence over detail; scoped to that value.

integer-detail.description: Mixed editor detail override when integer is selected. Takes precedence over detail; scoped to that value.

boolean-detail.description: Mixed editor detail override when boolean is selected. Takes precedence over detail; scoped to that value.

null-detail.description: Mixed editor detail override when null is selected. Takes precedence over detail; scoped to that value.

conditionalFields.description: Opt in to active conditional object field discovery (if/then/else and Draft-07 dependencies). Local false overrides config. Explicit detail layouts retain placement; inactive branch-only controls are omitted without deleting data.

choices.description: Selectable cards instead of a plain choice list. Each entry selects either a data value or a combinator branch; an entry carrying both says nothing a renderer can act on, which is why they are mutually exclusive.

value.description: The data value this card selects.

branch.description: The combinator branch this card selects, by index.

content.description: Presentation-only UI schema drawn inside the card.

selectedContent.description: Drawn instead of content while the card is selected.

detail.description: The editor the card reveals once selected.

showRadio.description: Keeps the native radio control visible inside each card. Hidden by default; keyboard interaction and accessible radio semantics remain either way.

showTypeIndicator.description: Show an object or array type marker in a composite cell, independently of its summary.

columnDefs.description: Selects and orders table or AG Grid columns with optional width constraints. Explicit agGridOptions.columnDefs replaces this list for AG Grid.

button.description: Named command or script body, mutually exclusive in authored JSON. A tolerant runtime diagnoses conflicts and gives the action precedence.

action.description: The command name handed to the host. Never derived from the label, which moves with the locale; `name` is the fallback.

script.description: An async function body, invoked with the ActionEvent as `this`. Requires jsonformsExtended.security.allowScriptEvaluation. A FUNCTION is also accepted by an in-memory TypeScript model and has no JSON spelling.

params.description: Arguments for the command, so one action serves several buttons.

color.description: Semantic names, not paint; the renderer set maps them.

fullWidth.description: Fill the available inline width of the containing layout cell without changing its size or span.

href.description: Subject to the URL policy. An empty href is permitted and non-navigating.

imageView.description: Static or data-bound image source. URL policy applies to either; alt is explicit, including an empty string for decoration.

scope.description: Reads the URL from the data instead of from the element.

spacer.description: Top-level size along the parent main axis; options.layout.weight may request flexible space.

templateLayout.description: A template rendered by a named engine. `template` is a STRING in the portable model; a native host profile may also accept a function, which has no JSON spelling and cannot be serialized.

elements.description: Children. A named child is addressable from the template; an unnamed one gets its decimal index as a fallback name.

templateLangRef.description: Not a closed enum: an unknown language must be diagnosed rather than interpreted as another engine, which a closed enum would make unauthorable.

name.description: Which named child of the enclosing template to place.

elements.description: The first child is fallback content when no named slot content is supplied. Wrap multiple controls in one layout.

detail.description: Editor detail: inline UI schema or upstream string mode. GENERATE bypasses the registry; other strings consult it. Tuple containers use a separate position-layout contract.

anyOf.description: Array detail: DEFAULT preserves normal presentation; GENERATE forces generation; REGISTERED and other strings (including GENERATED) use registry lookup with generation fallback. String comparisons are case-insensitive. Inline UI schemas are recursively validated.

label.description: A Label, plus the options the extended renderer set reads on one. References the base definition rather than restating it, so `text` and `options.format` keep one home.

markup.description: How the text is rendered. `markdown` parses it with the host's configured profile; anything other than these two is reported beside the text rather than guessed at. A renderer set that does not implement this ignores the option and shows the text as written, which is why this is an option and not an element type.

typography.description: Whether to wrap the rendered text in the UI library's own text components. Overrides jsonformsExtended.markup.typography for this element.

interpolate.description: Evaluates the {...} placeholders in this element's text. A single { opens a placeholder and {{ emits a literal brace - inverted from Mustache, so {{data.x}} is literal text. Inside is an expression, not merely a path. A renderer set that does not implement this ignores the option and shows the text as written.

textParams.description: Named values exposed to the expressions as bare identifiers. Always in scope, unlike the data/item/config/context namespaces, which require jsonformsExtended.dynamicValues.enabled.

name.description: Exact name of the registered UI-schema model (entry.uischema.name), not a ranked tester lookup.

collapsed.description: Initial panel visibility: true starts hidden; false starts visible. Panel presentation only.
